name: spanner-relational-to-graph
description: Analyzes existing Spanner relational schemas on Google Cloud (DDL, foreign keys, interleaved tables, and junction tables) and generates `CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH` DDL statements (`NODE TABLES`, `EDGE TABLES`) without modifying underlying relational tables. Use when mapping existing Spanner tables to a Spanner Graph, identifying node and edge candidates from relational tables, creating SQL bridge views for implicit `ARRAY`/`JSON` or type-mismatched relationships, mapping polymorphic or self-referential tables, or troubleshooting `CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH` DDL compiler errors. Don't use for greenfield physical table design (use spanner-graph-schema-best-practices) or tuning slow ISO GQL queries (use spanner-graph-query-tuning).
